response.original_title: Trilogy: The Triumph of Fragility, Immersion, In Memory of Poor Liza
response.overview: A trilogy of performances documentation, with all three performances exploring how vulnerability, tenderness, and "fragility" can serve as a powerful form of resistance against rigid, militaristic, or oppressive social structures. The first piece, The Triumph of Fragility, contrasts military discipline by showing naval cadets cradling miniature white dresses instead of weapons. The second piece, Immersion, places the artists in full scuba gear alongside white dresses underwater to stage a surreal, weightless fashion show. The third piece, In Memory of Poor Liza, features the artists jumping into a canal while holding a black dress that floats away, subverting the tragic themes of Karamzin's novella to celebrate female resilience.
